chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.name: The Rabbi
chapters.intro:
The third night of Hanukkah, early evening. You are the rabbi of the quarter.

All day there have been whispers in the market. Now men are gathering outside the tavern across the square.

Slip out through the quarter gate and listen to what they're planning, without being seen. A barrel by the tavern wall would hide you well.

Then go down to the riverbank. The old books say a guardian can be made from river clay.
chapters.goal: Go through the quarter gate and listen to the men outside the tavern.

listen.label: Overhear the plan
lines: "...when the bells ring midnight. Bring torches."
"They say a boy went missing near their wall."
"The baker's boy? He turned up at his uncle's this morning."
"Doesn't matter. People are angry. We start at the synagogue."
listen.done: You've heard enough. Midnight. Now the clay: three loads from the riverbank.

chapters.dug: You dig a load of cold, wet river clay.
chapters.not_yet: Not yet. You still need to hear their plan and bring back the clay.
chapters.outro:
In the synagogue attic, by candlelight, you and your student shape the clay into the form of a man, three times as tall as either of you.

Seven times you walk around it, saying the old words. Then you write on its forehead: emet, truth.

Its eyes open.

The bells are already ringing. "Take it," you tell your student. "Get everyone to the boat. I'll warn the far end of the quarter."

chapters.name: The Quarter
chapters.intro:
Midnight. A crowd with torches is moving on the Jewish quarter.

You are the rabbi's student. He has gone to warn the far end of the quarter and left the Golem with you. The elder has the synagogue's Torah scroll.
Find your neighbours hiding in their doorways and lead them to the boat at the river gate.

Stay out of the torchlight. Hide in barrels and hay carts. The Golem will hold them back, but it cannot be everywhere.
chapters.goal: Find your neighbours. Press E next to them.
chapters.not_yet: You can't leave yet. Some of your neighbours are still hiding in the quarter.
chapters.found: "We have to go to the river." Your %s follows you.
chapters.outro:
The boat pushes off into the dark. Behind you, the Golem walks into the river without slowing, and the black water closes over its head.

Halfway across, a shape rises beside the boat, streaming mud, and takes hold of the side to steady it.

chapters.name: The Mill Road
chapters.intro:
The boat can't go any further: the town watch is out on the bridge. You land below the old mill.

Beyond the mill yard and the fields is the forest road. Men from the town are searching the farms with lanterns.

Keep everyone together and get them to the trees. If they catch you, the others will scatter and hide, and you'll have to gather them again.
chapters.goal: Lead everyone across the fields to the forest edge.
chapters.not_yet: Not everyone is with you. Go back for them.
chapters.found: You find them. Your %s comes with you again.
chapters.outro:
Under the trees, the noise of the town fades. Someone counts heads.

One is missing. Little Rivka let go of her mother's hand in the fields and ran into the forest.

chapters.name: The Forest
chapters.intro:
Rivka is somewhere in the forest, and searchers with torches are walking the road.

Find her, then lead everyone to the gate of the next town, where the Jewish community has promised to take you in.

The paths are narrow. Hide in the bushes.
chapters.goal: Find Rivka. Then lead everyone to the town gate.
chapters.not_yet: You can't go in without Rivka.
chapters.found: Rivka! She takes your hand and doesn't let go.
chapters.outro:
At first light the village gate opens, and the little community there takes you in, Torah and all.

The Golem won't fit through a village gate. It stays at the edge of the forest, standing among the trees like an old stump, and every evening you walk out to see it.

You remember what the rabbi said: the word on its forehead is emet, truth. Wipe away the first letter and it reads met, dead.

You can't bring yourself to do it. Not yet.

chapters.name: The Village
chapters.intro:
Spring. Passover is a week away, and the village has made room for all of you.

But peddlers on the road bring news from the town: the story about the quarter has followed you here. One evening the church bell rings out of time, and you see torches coming down the hill road.

The village elders look at you, and at the Golem waiting at the edge of the forest.

choice.title: Fight, or flight?
choice.prompt: There isn't much time. What do you do?

options.name: Fight
options.summary: Stand with the Golem and defend the village. The families shelter in the synagogue.
options.intro:
You stay.

The families shelter in the synagogue, and you and the Golem stand in the lanes.

The mob will come in waves, going for the houses with torches. Beat out the fires before the houses burn down, and let the Golem drive them off: anyone it knocks down runs for good.

Lose three houses and the village is lost.
options.goal: Defend the village. Put out fires: E next to a burning door.
options.wave_text: Torches on the road. Here they come.
options.wave_cleared: They fall back up the hill. Not for long.
options.fire_text: A house is on fire! Put it out: E next to the door.
options.lost_text: The fires spread faster than you can beat them out, and the village is lost.
options.outro:
By dawn the torches have gone back up the hill road. The village is scorched, but it stands.

The Golem doesn't stop. It walks the lanes, still looking for someone to fight, and when it tears the village gate off its hinges, the elders look at you.

You reach up to its forehead. Emet becomes met, and the Golem falls into a heap of river clay in the middle of the road.

Whatever comes next, the village will face it with its own hands.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Leave. Gather the families and cross the marsh before the mob arrives.
options.intro:
You leave.

Five families are hiding in their houses, waiting for word. Gather them, then lead everyone south to the ford across the marsh.

The mob is coming down the hill road and along the east road, and more arrive all the time. They'll search the lanes.
options.goal: Gather the families and lead them to the ford (south-west).
options.not_yet: Not everyone is here. Go back for them.
options.found: "Is it time?" Your %s comes with you.
options.outro:
On the far side of the marsh, someone counts heads, and this time nobody is missing.

Behind you, the Golem stands in the ford alone, holding the way. The torches gather around it, and then the fog comes down.

In the morning there is only river clay on the bank, and the marks of a struggle. You never learn how many it turned back.
